SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. N.1437-F5-(3)
Date 25/9/42

September 18, 42.

Dr. Ed. Birt,
20, Kiukiang Road,
SHANGHAI.

Sir,

With reference to your letters of the 5th and
7th inst., wherein you request the issue of special
passes for passage through blockaded areas for the
members of the Shanghai Foreign Medical Practitioners
Association, I have to state that passes of this
nature are not issued by the Police.

However, I have to suggest that application may
be submitted through the applicant's respective Consu-
lar Authorities to the Japanese Authorities for
consideration.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(SD) S. GOTO
Acting Commissioner of Police.

Sept. Umemoto

Note and

埃德·柏德医生（Dr. Ed. Birt），
九江路20号，
上海。

先生：

关于您本月5日和7日的来信，信中请求为上海外籍医师协会成员签发通过封锁区域的特别通行证，本人须声明，此类通行证并非由警务处签发。

然而，本人建议，申请人可通过各自的领事当局向日本当局提交申请，以供审议。

此致，
敬礼

（签名） S. GOTO
代理警务处处长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Foreign Pao Chia Office Station. File No.................... Date Sept. 10, 1942.
SUBJECT: Letters from Dr. Birt .
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter from Dr. Birt
the undersigned begs to report that on 2-9-42 Dr. A.
Renner, residing at 229 Cardinal Mercier, French Con-
cession, called at the office of the Foreign Pao Chia
and informed the undersigned that he wished to obtain
passes through blocked streets by the Pao Chia for
foreign doctors.
The undersigned wanted to refer Dr. Renner to Mr.
Shigeta, but the latter was busy in conference. Therefore
the undersigned advised Dr. Renner to ask Dr. Birt,
President of the Doctors Union to state in writing the
desire of the doctors.
The foreign doctors wish to have passes authorising
them to pass through streets blockaded by the Pao Chia.
I am Sir,
Your obediently
N. J. Pokrovsky
Officer in Charge , S. B.
Foreign Affairs
No special passes are being issued
to foreign doctors. Consideration,
however, will be given to applications
submitted through the Consular Authorities
of any doctor desiring such passes.
D.C. (C & Sp. Br.)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
外籍保甲办公站。档案号.................... 日期 1942年9月10日。
主题：柏德医生的来信。
先生：
关于附上的柏德医生来信，具报人谨报告如下：1942年9月2日，居住在法租界麦兰神父路229号的A.雷纳医生（Dr. A. Renner）造访外籍保甲办公室，并告知具报人，他希望获得由保甲签发的、供外国医生通过街道封锁线的通行证。
具报人欲将雷纳医生引荐给重田先生（Mr. Shigeta），但后者正忙于会议。因此，具报人建议雷纳医生请医生公会主席柏德医生以书面形式陈述医生们的愿望。
外国医生希望获得授权其通过由保甲封锁的街道的通行证。
此致，
敬礼
N. J. Pokrovsky
主管官员，特别科
外事股

不向外籍医生签发特别通行证。
然而，任何希望获得此类通行证的医生，若通过其领事当局提交申请，将予以考虑。
副 commissioner（刑事及特别科）
